name: Malkiel
title: Son of Beriah
summary: Malkiel was a son of Beriah and grandson of Asher, Jacob's son. He is the ancestor of the Malkielites, a clan within the tribe of Asher. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles as part of Israel's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: Born as son of Beriah
keyEvents.description: Malkiel is mentioned as a son of Beriah, grandson of Asher, in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Malkiel was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt with Jacob, totaling seventy persons.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the Malkielites
keyEvents.description: In the census on the plains of Moab, Malkiel is mentioned as the ancestor of the clan of the Malkielites within the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Malkiel is listed in the detailed genealogy of 1 Chronicles as a son of Beraiah, with Birzait being named as his son.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Malkiel belonged to the tribe of Asher, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and his descendants formed an important part of the tribe's structure.
